service_description: SmartInvest Pro is an AI-powered investment advisory platform that provides personalized portfolio recommendations, real-time market insights, and automated rebalancing. Features include: tax-loss harvesting, diversified ETF portfolios, dedicated financial advisor access, and a minimum investment of just ₹10,000. Currently offering 3 months free for new signups.
campaign_objective: Your goal is to promote our new SmartInvest Pro package, gauge the client's current investment situation, assess their interest level, and schedule a free 15-minute portfolio review call with our specialist team.

questions.text: How would you rate your experience with our existing services on a scale of 1 to 5?
Are you currently investing with any other provider?
Would you be interested in a free 15-minute portfolio review?
What matters most to you when it comes to investing — returns, safety, or flexibility?
What would be the best day and time for us to follow up with you?
